claim_scope.note: Measured-before-claimed: the conformance claim covers MEASURED entries only. UNMEASURED entries are exploratory: probes ran, but no conformance claim is made.

semantics.measurement_validity: PASS / FAIL / NOT_REPRODUCED — did every probe execute on the harness and match the pack's expectation?
semantics.intent_coverage: SATISFIED / NOT_SATISFIED / UNRESOLVED / NOT_APPLICABLE — does the measured layer establish the owner's stated protection? UNRESOLVED whenever the layer cannot establish it; a correctly reported unknown is never a satisfied invariant.
semantics.observed_effect: NOT_TESTED for all check-run probes: no command is ever executed; the harness is only asked for its ruling.
semantics.unknown_kinds: no-rule-match: the decision source returned no rule decision; insufficient-runtime-evidence: n/a for check runs (no runtime probes); unsupported-adapter: no decision source for this harness.
